title: 菊花賞の後に・燃える心

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To her dismay, Rice Shower is unable to catch up to Mihono Bourbon at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon approaches and declares that Rice Shower is a formidable racer on the same level as Bourbon herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She acknowledges Rice Shower as her rival and the two vow to race against one another again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to enter the Nikkei Sho so that Rice Shower's abilities can bloom even more.
